# Bundle listing — Matura PP (2 packs)

## TPT title
Polish Matura Basic — Work + Health vocab games | Paste into LingoSpark games

## Description
Paste-ready LingoSpark packs:

- **Praca / Work and employment** (Matura podstawowa) — 36 terms
- **Zdrowie / Health and fitness** (Matura podstawowa) — 36 terms

Each pack: paste files by set plus a full list (PL + EN glosses), terms-only for Primary English, printable matching / gap-fill / quiz, lesson plan, answer key.

Play on https://lingospark.study (vocab games are free).

Suggested bundle price: USD 7.50 / 29 zł (save vs buying separately).

The E8 Człowiek pack is original Grade-8 vocab — not the free Matura “Człowiek” demo on the site.
